title: Chess club meeting
text:
From: Chess Club Officers
To: Club Members
Subject: This week's meeting

Hi everyone,

This Thursday's meeting will be held in the Student Union, Room 3B, instead of our usual classroom, which is being used for exams. We'll still start at 6 p.m. Since we'll have more space, we're opening the meeting to non-members, so feel free to bring a friend who'd like to learn the game. Beginners will play on the boards near the window, where two experienced members will give tips.

See you there!

questions.prompt: Why has the meeting place changed?
options: The club has too many members for its usual room.
The meeting will start at a different time.
The Student Union offers better boards.
The usual classroom is needed for exams.
questions.explanation: El aula habitual se está usando para exámenes.
questions.evidence: instead of our usual classroom, which is being used for exams
optionNotes: El espacio extra es una consecuencia del cambio, no la causa.
La hora no cambia: «We'll still start at 6 p.m.»
No se compara la calidad de los tableros.
Correcta.

questions.prompt: What can be inferred about the club's usual meetings?
options: They normally take place in the Student Union.
They are normally open only to club members.
They normally start at 7 p.m.
They are normally only for beginners.
questions.explanation: Dicen que «esta vez» abren la reunión a no socios porque hay más espacio, lo que implica que normalmente no lo hacen.
questions.evidence: Since we'll have more space, we're opening the meeting to non-members
optionNotes: Normalmente se reúnen en un aula; la Student Union es sólo esta semana.
Correcta.
Siguen empezando a las 6, como siempre.
Los principiantes tendrán una zona, pero también hay jugadores con experiencia.

title: Bulk item collection
text:
Bulk Item Collection — Pine Hill Neighborhood

Once a year, the city collects large household items that do not fit in regular trash bins. This year's collection will take place on Saturday, April 18.

Items accepted: furniture, mattresses, carpets, and large appliances such as washing machines. Refrigerators and freezers are accepted only if a certificate shows that the cooling gas has been removed.

Items not accepted: paint, car tires, building materials, and electronics. Electronics can be dropped off free of charge at the Recycling Center on Mill Road on any weekday.

Place items at the curb no earlier than 6 p.m. on Friday, April 17, and no later than 7 a.m. on the day of collection.

options: To announce a new recycling center on Mill Road
To ask residents to stop using regular trash bins
To warn residents about fines for leaving items on the street
To explain how residents can use a yearly collection service

questions.evidence: Once a year, the city collects large household items that do not fit in regular trash bins.
optionNotes: El centro de reciclaje se menciona como alternativa, no como novedad.
Los contenedores normales se siguen usando.
No se mencionan multas.
Correcta.

optionNotes: Correcta.

optionNotes: Los muebles («furniture») sí se aceptan.
Correcta.

title: Movie plans
text:

title: Travel grant eligibility
text:
Walker Travel Grant — Eligibility and Application

The Walker Travel Grant funds up to $1,500 for undergraduate students to present their research at academic conferences. Applicants must be enrolled full-time and have completed at least one year of study at the university. Students in their final semester are eligible only if the conference takes place before their graduation date.

Applications must be submitted at least six weeks before the conference begins and must include a letter from a faculty supervisor. Students who received a Walker Grant in the past may apply again, but priority is given to first-time applicants.

Funds are paid as a reimbursement: recipients pay their own expenses first and submit receipts within 30 days of returning.

questions.prompt: Which student would NOT be eligible for the grant?
options: A full-time second-year student presenting at a conference in three months
A full-time student who received the grant last year
A full-time third-year student whose supervisor has written a letter
A final-semester student whose conference is one month after graduation
questions.explanation: Los estudiantes del último semestre sólo pueden optar si el congreso es antes de su graduación.
questions.evidence: Students in their final semester are eligible only if the conference takes place before their graduation date.
optionNotes: Cumple: tiempo completo, más de un año y hay tiempo para pedirla con seis semanas.
Puede volver a pedirla; sólo tendrá menos prioridad.
Cumple todos los requisitos mencionados.
Correcta: el congreso es después de graduarse.

questions.prompt: How are grant funds provided?
options: They are paid to students before they travel.
They are paid back to students after they submit receipts.
They are paid to the conference organizers directly.
They are given to the faculty supervisor to manage.
questions.explanation: Es un reembolso: el estudiante paga primero y presenta los recibos en los 30 días posteriores a la vuelta.
questions.evidence: recipients pay their own expenses first and submit receipts within 30 days of returning
optionNotes: Es al revés: primero paga el estudiante.
Correcta.
No se menciona.
El supervisor sólo escribe la carta.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about students who have received the grant before?
options: They are not allowed to apply again.
They do not need a letter from a supervisor.
They can receive only half of the usual amount.
They may be less likely to receive it than new applicants.
questions.explanation: Pueden volver a solicitarla, pero los que la piden por primera vez tienen prioridad, así que sus posibilidades son menores.
questions.evidence: priority is given to first-time applicants
optionNotes: Falso: «may apply again».
La carta es obligatoria para todas las solicitudes.
No se dice nada de cantidades reducidas.
Correcta.

title: Fall swimming lessons
text:
Lakeview Community Center — Fall Swimming Lessons

Level 1 (ages 4–6): Mondays and Wednesdays, 4:00–4:30 p.m.
Level 2 (ages 6–9): Tuesdays and Thursdays, 4:30–5:15 p.m.
Level 3 (ages 9–12): Saturdays, 10:00–11:00 a.m.
Adult beginners: Thursdays, 7:00–8:00 p.m.

Each course runs for eight weeks and costs $80 ($65 for community center members). Children placed in Level 2 or 3 for the first time must pass a short swimming test on September 6.

title: Order problem reply
text:
From: Customer Care, BrightHome Store
To: Kevin Moss
Subject: Re: Order #48213

Dear Mr. Moss,

Thank you for contacting us about your order. We're sorry that the desk lamp arrived with a cracked base. We have sent a replacement, which should reach you within 3–5 business days. There is no need to return the damaged lamp; you may recycle it or keep it for parts.

You also asked about the bookshelf from the same order. It is currently out of stock at our warehouse and is expected to ship on May 22. If you would prefer not to wait, you can cancel that item from your account page and receive a full refund.

Best regards,
Customer Care Team

To advertise a new line of desk lamps
To reply to a customer's complaint and question about an order
To confirm that a customer has cancelled an order
questions.explanation: Responde a Kevin sobre la lámpara rota y sobre la estantería por la que preguntó.

No es publicidad.
Correcta.

title: Coworking space policy update
text:
Updated Policy for Hot Desk Members — Hive Workspace

Effective March 1, hot desk members may reserve a desk up to seven days in advance, rather than the current two days. Reservations not checked in by 10 a.m. will be released automatically so that other members can use the desk.

Meeting rooms remain available to all members at no charge for the first two hours each month. Additional time is billed at $15 per hour, except for Premium members, who receive ten free hours.

Finally, because of repeated complaints about noise, phone calls are no longer permitted in the open work area. Members may use the phone booths on each floor, which do not require a reservation.

options: Desks can now be reserved further in advance.
Members must now check in by 9 a.m.
Reservations will now require a fee.
Only Premium members will be able to reserve desks.
questions.explanation: Antes se podía reservar con dos días de antelación; ahora con hasta siete.
questions.evidence: may reserve a desk up to seven days in advance, rather than the current two days
optionNotes: Correcta.
El límite para hacer el check-in es las 10:00.
No se menciona ningún pago por reservar mesa.
La norma es para todos los miembros de hot desk.

questions.prompt: A member who is not a Premium member uses a meeting room for a total of five hours in March. How much will she be charged?
questions.explanation: Las dos primeras horas del mes son gratis; las tres restantes se cobran a 15 $: 3 × 15 = 45 $.

optionNotes: Sólo los Premium tienen diez horas gratis.

Correcta.
